properties.description: Relational Engine owns semantic data types, typed query operators and validation at value, field, cross-field and cross-node scope. Contributors declare types and rules through enforcing APIs; Relational UI discovers renderers and displays diagnostics. Replace generic planning-node projection and hidden queue brackets with faithful declarations. Required field comments, read-only fields, inherited priority, stages and review consistency must be enforced through UI and tools.
properties.title: Enforce contributor-owned types, references and invariants
